name: zsnd_sample_set_destroy_owned_data
description: zSndSampleSet::DestroyOwnedData releases loaded sample resources through Destroy, frees the owned sample array and set name, and clears the sample count.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /MD /O2 /Ob1 /GX /Zp4 /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?DestroyOwnedData@zSndSampleSet@@QAEXXZ at 0x4a0c00 passed with zero unmasked mismatches after 8 COFF relocation bytes were masked; Binary Ninja body is 50 bytes, the VC object symbol is 64 bytes with 14 trailing VC NOP bytes trimmed, and evidence is under build/vc5-verify/zsnd_sample_set_destroy_owned_data/verify. The earlier vc5_o2_ob0_facs and vc5_o2_ob1_gx_facs attempts both failed with 34 mismatches because they emitted direct _free calls instead of the retail reused CRT import pointer shape.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a0c00 validates the thiscall ABI, call to zSndSampleSet::Destroy, conditional free(samples), conditional free(setName), and clearing sampleCount while leaving the freed pointer fields unchanged.

The focused native smoke verifies DestroyOwnedData clears resourcesLoaded through Destroy, clears sampleCount, leaves the samples and setName fields unchanged after freeing them, and handles the all-null/empty case.
The registry lookup/destroy smoke verifies zSndSampleSetRegistry::DestroyAll reaches this helper for heap-owned registered sets.
